title: RenYing - a 1v1/2v2/3v3/tag chinese traditional konfu game, a demonstration of mass-training ai in-game
author: launchd_0
selftext:
hey guys, i am a lil secondary student and my cs teacher asks us to learn how to train AI. so i think it would be a gud idea to train AI into this chill stickman game.  
even though the focus is on training the AI, i still decided to make it into a game.

the game should be fun, but I also wonna challenge you guys. i don't think the God level AI could be beaten by anyone.

I'm a new dev, so this game is not very good as other GTA-level great games, but I hope you can try and support me! thank you so much!

this game was made by gemini 4 argon, claude opus, fable, with opus 5.5 the main fighter!

the open source link is at:  
[GitHub Repo](https://github.com/AMFI-Disable/RenYing)

play the game at:  
[RenYing](http://amfi-disable.github.io/RenYing/)

ps im from singapore so sorry if the screenshots are in chinese. you can set the language the first time you enter the game.

pps you can try this fun nonsense 3d game if you like nonsense xd
